data.title: AlUla Languages Institute Marks Five Years of Language and Heritage Learning
data.content:
AlUla, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The AlUla Languages Institute, a Royal Commission for AlUla initiative for human capability development, has recorded 6,658 beneficiaries of its courses since its launch in November 2021, coinciding with its fifth anniversary.
    The institute offers courses in modern languages, including English, French, Chinese, and Arabic for non-native speakers, as well as in ancient languages linked to AlUla’s history. The English courses include general, intensive, and specialized tracks, among them tourism and hospitality fundamentals.
    The courses in ancient languages cover scripts such as Dadanitic, Thamudic, Nabataean, Aramaic, and Southern Musnad, which trace the civilizations of AlUla, with educational visits to sites including Jabal Ikmah and Hegra.
    The institute has 19 classrooms with 330 seats and 28 teachers, offering courses at different levels for students, employees, and anyone interested in learning languages.
    The institute’s work supports the commission’s efforts to develop national capabilities and strengthen knowledge of the governorate’s linguistic and cultural heritage, in line with Saudi Vision 2030.
    -- SPA
